subject: arcticOutpost
pitch:
Category: Diorama.
Subject: arctic research outpost.
Style: Firewatch flat colour.

requests.what: Neon weather light bar across the cab roof: a slim dark housing, six chunky lamps alternating CYAN and MAGENTA, and two metal brackets. Keep it graphic and high-contrast.
Paint the clear sign board with a bold cream arctic research emblem and the words POLAR STATION in block lettering, using SNOW_LIGHT, YELLOW, and INK.
Add a satellite dish feed assembly: a slim arm, a small receiver pod, and two little braces in METAL_LIGHT, with one CYAN indicator.
Build a crisp antenna crown on the mast: three different-length whip antennas, a crossbar, small insulators, and a red warning pennant. Use METAL, METAL_DARK, RED, and YELLOW.
Add a bundled exterior communications cable running from the rear side of the cabin toward the mast, with three square cable clips and a small junction box.
Add a bright yellow hazard stencil and two dark bands to the pair of fuel drums. Keep the lettering abstract and graphic, not realistic.
Lay a clean six-by-four grid of pale blue solar cells into the two angled panels, with a dark perimeter frame and two bright corner glints.
Fill the orange cargo sled with three strapped expedition cases, a rolled orange tarp, and two pale snow hooks. Use CRATE, CRATE_LIGHT, ORANGE, and METAL.
Place a short striped snow marker pole at the front corner, with alternating RED and SNOW_LIGHT bands and a tiny triangular flag.

Paint a restrained Firewatch-style geometric weathering pattern on the left hull side: broad HULL_LIGHT and HULL_DARK diagonal blocks, with a few SNOW_BLUE frost streaks. Keep the windows and trim clear.
Paint the right hull side with offset HULL and HULL_DARK field patches and a faded cream unit number near the rear, leaving the cable route readable.
Add graphic snow streaks and wind-scoured bands to both roof planes using SNOW_LIGHT, SNOW_BLUE, and ROOF_LIGHT. Keep the roof light bar mounting strip plain.
Give the solar panels a crisp alternating PANEL and PANEL_DARK cell pattern with thin ICE highlights and a subtle diagonal reflection.
